review_summary: The final JSON code_steps list has 8 candidate steps. S2 gives non-alert CBC EDR/NGAV evidence that discord.exe created cmd.exe, and S3 gives the cmd.exe command line containing /q /d /s /c and nvidia-smi.exe, so both C09 gold behavior-plus-evidence steps are recovered in order. S1 is upstream update-to-Discord setup, and S4-S8 are module-load or process-terminate details for the same cmd.exe process, so they are denominator-only extras. Alert summary text is not used for non-alert credit.

The final JSON code_steps list has 2 candidate steps. S1 reports reg.exe querying HKCU Software Microsoft Windows CurrentVersion Run /v Discord with non-alert CBC EDR command-line evidence and Discord parent evidence, covering the Discord-to-reg parent behavior plus the query behavior. S2 reports reg.exe adding the Discord Run value with non-alert CBC EDR/NGAV ACTION_WRITE_VALUE and regmod evidence, covering the write behavior. CBC alert rows are only supporting context and are not credited by themselves as non-alert evidence.
